The '''tortur''' were large quadrupedal [[Species/Legends|beasts]] native to [[Talus/Legends|Talus]].

Torturs were a close genetic cousin of the [[torton]] of [[Rori/Legends|Rori]]. They had a large back shell, as well as four other plates of hard body armor. Two short horns grew from their snout, in a vertical fashion. Both their skin and armor plating came in hues of either red or green.
